name: Mindset & Worldview
description: How you see life, reality, and the future.

questions.text: If you could know the absolute truth about one thing, what would you choose?
options: Whether we're alone in the universe
Whether reality is actually a simulation

questions.text: Which statement feels closest to how you see life?
options: Life is mostly chance and consequences
I don't think humans understand enough to know

questions.text: You can see one thing from your future. What do you look at?

name: Emotions & Relationships
description: How relationships and emotions affect you.

questions.text: Everyone has forgotten your birthday, including at midnight. What would genuinely affect you most?
options: I'd wonder whether I matter to people as much as I thought
I'd probably joke about it and move on
Honestly, birthdays aren't important to me

questions.text: You can permanently erase one embarrassing or painful memory. What do you choose?
options: The time someone seriously hurt me
Nothing—my memories made me who I am

questions.text: You can know exactly what people feel about you, but can never ask why. Would you take it?
options: Only for people I care about
I'd rather judge people by how they treat me

name: Values & Moral Choices
description: The principles and trade-offs that matter to you.

questions.text: Your dream career would require you to become someone you don't particularly like. The money and success are almost guaranteed. What feels closest to you?
options: Take it, but try not to lose myself
Walk away; liking who I become matters more
I'd need to know exactly what I'm sacrificing first

questions.text: You can secretly see one number above everyone's head. Which number would you choose?
You can guarantee one sentence will be true about you at the end of your life. Which one?

name: Weird, Funny & Personality
description: Unexpected questions about your personality and imagination.

questions.text: You have to live as one animal for a year. Which life are you choosing?
options: Lion—I'm not explaining myself to anybody

questions.text: Aliens arrive tomorrow and you have to show them one thing that explains humanity. What do you show them?
You're invisible for exactly 24 hours. What sounds most tempting?
options: Explore places I'm never allowed into
Listen to what people really say about me
I'd genuinely rather not be invisible

name: Friendship & Social Energy
description: How you connect with friends and other people.

questions.text: You walk alone into a party where you know nobody. Thirty minutes later, where are you?
options: Deep in conversation with one person
Hanging around food until someone adopts me

questions.text: What makes someone become a real friend to you?
options: They're there when things go wrong
We can have ridiculous fun together
Months can pass and nothing changes

questions.text: Your closest friend hasn't contacted you for two months. What do you naturally think?
options: I'd wonder if something is wrong
If they don't make an effort, neither will I

name: Lifestyle & Experiences
description: The experiences and ways of spending time you prefer.

questions.text: Someone gives you a free ticket tonight. You must leave tomorrow. Where are you going?
options: Don't tell me the destination—surprise me

questions.text: You unexpectedly get three months completely free with your salary still coming. What happens?
options: Spend serious time with family and friends
Sleep first, figure life out later

questions.text: You have AED 5,000 that you absolutely cannot save. What are you spending it on?
options: An incredible meal or weekend with people I love
Learn a skill I've always wanted, shopping

name: Ambition, Money & Future
description: Your ambitions, priorities, and hopes for the future.

questions.text: Two buttons. You must press one.
options: 30% chance of becoming extremely wealthy, 70% chance of starting again from zero

questions.text: You're 45. Which situation would make you feel most successful?
AED 1 million unexpectedly lands in your account—legally yours. What is your first instinct?
options: Take some and create unforgettable experiences

name: The Curiosity Room
description: Unexpected what-if questions to see how other people think.

questions.text: You wake up tomorrow and everyone on Earth has disappeared except 100 people. What is your first thought?
options: Explore everything I was never allowed to

questions.text: A button gives you AED 10 million, but one random stranger somewhere loses AED 10 million. You will never know them. Do you press it?
You can read people's minds, but you can never turn it off. Do you take the ability?
options: No, some things are better unknown

name: Visual Images
description: Questions based on images. New questions will be added later.
